content.short: Biconomy Core is a multi-chain relayer platform that manages transactions, gas payments, and bridges for Web3 apps.
content.description: Biconomy Core is a multi-chain, plug-and-play relayer platform that handles transactions, gas payments, and bridges for Web3 applications across Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, and Avalanche. Users can leverage smart contract wallets and design custom transaction journeys within a single platform. For developers, it provides SDKs and APIs to build decentralized applications with a tailored transaction flow, enabling smoother onboarding and a streamlined user experience. This combination helps projects simplify onboarding, reduce friction in transactions, and support flexible routing across multiple networks.
